title: Prepare and preview private job application packets
summary: Prepare unsent Cast jobs as a concise sectioned brief and Jackson-only tailored resume, preview up to three packets, and explicitly send a normal edition or an isolated test from retained material.
use_when: The user wants a private brief and a constrained tailored resume for a retained Cast job.
The user wants to prepare or preview an edition of up to three previously unsent opportunities, inspect retained status, or explicitly send a frozen edition.
The user explicitly wants an ad hoc test email using retained completed packets without source/API refresh or changes to ordinary packet sent flags.
do_not_use_when: The request is job discovery, CRM editing, employer outreach or application submission.
The caller expects an installed automatic 09:00 delivery service or a change to any fixed resume content.
outcome: Accepted brief and Jackson bullets are retained with source evidence and a rendered resume; a preview freezes one through three ready packets, and an explicit authorized send records provider acceptance separately.

interfaces.label: Freeze and preview a dated edition
Preview retained packets as an isolated test
Preview an isolated test with reviewed paragraph overrides

effects: Initialization captures a private original resume template and creates local configuration/state.

Preparation reads Cast export and CRM profile list/read interfaces, fetches full supported employer posting evidence, submits two sequential constrained Nucleus jobs when pursuit is appropriate, and renders local resume artifacts.

Preview rechecks supported full posting evidence before freezing, retains exact brief text and copied PDF attachments, and reserves selected opportunities. Explicit send invokes fixed-recipient Email with the retained payload and occurrence key.

Ad hoc preview reads retained packet rows/stages/artifacts and creates only an isolated test occurrence with copied PDFs. It makes no Cast, CRM, source HTTP, Nucleus or rendering call. Ad hoc send updates only that occurrence and invokes the selected fixed-recipient Email implementation.
authority: Platter validates and retains domain results independently of Nucleus terminal prose.
Only Jackson work-experience bullet contents may be authored. Every byte of the original resume source outside that span stays fixed.
A caller must already authorize the exact external send. Stored delivery settings, model output, preview and catalog presence do not grant send authority.
An ad hoc receipt does not reserve an ordinary packet or mark it sent. Test-send authority is explicit and does not create recurring-send authority.
success: Preparation is ready only when the accepted brief and resume content are retained and the fixed-template resume renders successfully.
Preview durably selects an edition without sending it. Email acceptance records submission, not inbox receipt or an application outcome.
Ad hoc preview freezes a separate test payload without changing ordinary domain state; ad hoc send records acceptance only in that occurrence.
failure_and_recovery: Retain original template, captured inputs, stage requests, accepted results, tool receipts, PDFs, database and edition files together. Reinvoke preparation to inspect or resume exact retained stage work; changed stage inputs are rejected.
Already reserved or sent opportunities are excluded from later editions. An uncertain send is held and is not blindly repeated.
There is no automatic replacement-job retry, ambiguous-send reconciliation command or schedule. Resolve exceptional state through a reviewed product change; never rewrite database rows to bypass it.

An accepted ad hoc occurrence is not resent under the same RUN_ID. A sending or uncertain occurrence remains held. Retain its payload and receipt; a different RUN_ID represents a separately authorized test.
privacy: Private state includes career history, preferences, contact details, source text and tailored resumes. Keep it outside the repository and exclude it from commits.
Nucleus and its model receive captured career material. Only an explicitly authorized send discloses the brief and resume to the fixed personal recipient via Email, Resend and Gmail.
does_not_authorize: Installing or enabling any scheduled activation.
Sending when the user requested only preparation or preview.
Changing fixed resume content, modifying CRM or Cast state, applying to a job or contacting an employer.

consumers.statement: The current user and an explicitly authorized local caller can operate the Platter CLI.

preconditions.statement: Preparation requires initialized private Platter state, the original supported LaTeX resume template, readable supported Cast and CRM interfaces, full supported employer posting evidence, strict compatible authenticated Nucleus readiness and local resume rendering tools. Send additionally requires an authorized frozen edition and Email attachment support.

Ad hoc operations require existing retained completed packet artifacts and writable private ad hoc occurrence storage; they require no source, Cast, CRM or Nucleus readiness. Sending additionally requires explicit test-send authority and a compatible fixed-recipient Email executable.

inputs.statement: Inputs are an original absolute resume path at initialization, an optional selected private state directory, an exact Cast job ID for individual preparation, or a YYYY-MM-DD edition date. Configuration retains executable paths, count three, 09:00 and America/Chicago by default. Optional --stop-after-seconds requests an explicit bounded invocation; it is not a daily budget.

Preview and send accept --ad-hoc RUN_ID for an isolated test. Preview optionally selects repeated --packet PACKET_ID values. Ad hoc send may select --email-executable ABS without changing normal configuration. RUN_ID contains 1 through 80 ASCII letters, digits, underscores or hyphens. Optional --brief-overrides ABS_JSON maps selected packet IDs to reviewed single paragraphs of at most 150 words. Without --packet, preview selects the first up to three retained complete records by packet ID, including ordinary sent or reserved records.

Fresh default state is ~/.local/share/platter. If only ~/.local/share/job-packets exists, continue using it in place. If both exist, an explicit --state-dir is required. The rename preserves original templates, packet identities, absolute artifact paths, retained Nucleus requests and send receipts.

outputs.statement: New preparation retains a labeled Why it works and Role brief with optional Culture, a private pursuit assessment, plain-text Jackson bullets with private career-entry references, generated LaTeX and PDF. The rendered brief remains in the existing paragraph string field. Preview retains subject, body, ordered PDF files, packet identities and idempotency key. Status reports local records; send retains acceptance or unresolved state.

Ad hoc preview and send retain independent occurrence.json, copied PDF files, exact TEST message, payload/attachment hashes, stable key and receipt under ad-hoc/RUN_ID; ordinary packet and edition state is untouched.

data_semantics.statement: New briefs contain at most 90 words across sections. Why it works gives one or two direct, confident, evidence-grounded sentences of at most 45 words. Role states stack, responsibilities and process expectations in one or two short lines of at most 30 words. Optional Culture states working norms in one or two short lines of at most 25 words. Role and Culture make no comparison with the user's experience. Displayed briefs omit caveats, downsides and hedging; pursuit criteria remain private. Career references establish provenance, not verified truth. The resume model cannot author fixed sections, dates, identity, employers, projects, skills or layout.

A test occurrence uses retained material only and does not establish current posting availability. Its acceptance is independent of ordinary daily sent history. Reviewed paragraph overrides affect only the test occurrence; it retains the original accepted brief and source-state hashes without editing original artifacts.

identity_and_units.statement: Opportunity identity uses supported canonical ATS namespace/tenant/posting identities or normalized posting URLs; edition identity is its requested date. Three is a ceiling on complete packets, not a quota. Equivalent repostings that lack shared identifiers may remain unresolved.

An ad hoc RUN_ID names one exact independent test occurrence. Reuse preserves the captured day, selected packets and exact payload; a new ID represents a new authorized test. Supplied packet order or override mappings must agree with an existing occurrence; a deliberately changed payload needs a new ID.

completeness_and_freshness.statement: Both stages use the same retained posting and captured CRM library. Culture appears only when supported by the posting or existing captured material; otherwise it is omitted without extra research or an uncertainty note. CRM separate list/read calls are not a transactional snapshot; capture checks entry timestamps and refuses incomplete list results. Cast excerpts alone do not satisfy full posting input. A new preview rechecks full posting evidence and defers changed or unavailable sources; reopening an already frozen edition does not refresh it.
No guarantee covers all employers, application requirements behind forms, perfect duplicate detection, current vacancy truth, or complete career evidence.
Ad hoc preview does no freshness recheck, discovery export, profile retrieval, model invocation or rendering. It reads existing accepted artifacts only and consumes no Cast API budget.

access.statement: Models can list/read captured career entries and submit only their stage output. They have no direct CRM database, shell, general filesystem, web or messaging authority. Local files and Nucleus access remain current-user protected.

Ad hoc packet listing uses read-only SQLite access to Platter's own domain state. An optional absolute Email executable override is invocation-local. A temporary copy of the existing Email wrapper may select a tested candidate while preserving its private credential and stdin procedure.

lifecycle_and_consistency.statement: Exact stage requests and tool responses are retained before ambiguous transport and replayed by identity. Accepted brief survives resume failure. Preview reserves ready opportunities and copies attachments. Confirmed acceptance marks selected opportunities sent; ambiguous send stays held.

Ad hoc occurrence state and payload are isolated from normal reservations, editions and sent flags. Payload/attachment hashes are verified before send, uncertainty is persisted before transport, accepted repeats do not resend and unresolved attempts remain held.

operational_limits.statement: No candidate or token budget caps daily preparation. Model gpt-5.6-sol with max effort runs brief then resume. Individual execution, network and rendering safety timeouts remain. Full posting adapters and one-page original-template rendering impose explicit input limits; runtime allowance and provider limits still apply.
No preparation-latency, completion-time, delivery-time or throughput guarantee exists. The stored 09:00 setting has no activation mechanism in this release.

compatibility_and_evolution.statement: Package/provider 0.1.1 and preparation contract 2 describe this source release. New brief jobs use platter/brief/2 and platter.submit-brief.arguments.v2 with why_it_works, role, optional culture and private pursue fields. Retained v1 requests and accepted outputs remain supported without rewriting them; existing frozen editions are unchanged. New editions separate headers and brief sections with whitespace and omit the packet-count footer. Ad hoc editions preserve retained sectioned briefs and continue accepting reviewed single-paragraph overrides of at most 150 words. Source-built and installed CLI behavior share this contract; only a published installed selector advertises local availability.

No template replacement, incompatible domain-state migration, future model support interval or deprecation window is promised. Installation and supported schema-compatible recovery have their own contract.

reliances.statement: Retained job evidence and stable discovery IDs come from Cast supported exports.
Career entries come from CRM supported profile list and read operations.
Constrained execution, authentication and durable requester-tool transport rely on Nucleus.
Explicit fixed-recipient submission with local attachments relies on Email contract 4.
Full posting retrieval depends on employer HTTPS sources and their supported ATS or JobPosting representations.
PDF generation depends on locally available LaTeX, fonts and PDF inspection executables.
